otherGems.quote: Action Text 8.1 depends on the `action_text-trix` gem (Trix 2.1.15), but the app keeps loading its own 1.3.5.

otherFindings.summary: Action Text plain-text conversion now drops script/style text and changes list numbering, which changes Markdown export contents.
The "Astana" time zone now maps to Asia/Almaty (UTC+5), which shifts reminder times by an hour for those readers.
The built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated in 8.1, and moving to Sidekiq 7.3 would break the sadd digest check, the Redis error rescue and symbol-key arguments.
The 7.1 `action_text.sanitizer_vendor` default switches Action Text to the HTML5 sanitizer if adopted.
